Salesforce.one_liner: Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, and marketing automation.
Salesforce.notes: Free developer edition available. Extensive REST+SOQL+GraphQL API. Composio already has a Salesforce toolkit.

HubSpot.one_liner: CRM platform with marketing, sales, and service tools.
HubSpot.notes: Free tier includes API access. Private app tokens or OAuth2 for public apps.

Pipedrive.one_liner: Sales CRM for small teams with pipeline management.
Pipedrive.notes: Free developer sandbox available. Personal API tokens for dev, OAuth2 for marketplace apps.

Attio.one_liner: Modern CRM with flexible data modeling and relationship intelligence.
Attio.notes: Free plan includes API access. Bearer token auth. OpenAPI spec available.

Twenty.one_liner: Open-source CRM with modern UI and customizable data model.
Twenty.notes: Open-source, self-hostable. REST and GraphQL APIs generated from workspace schema. OAuth2 with PKCE.

Podio.one_liner: Flexible work management platform with customizable apps and workflows.
Podio.notes: Free plan available. OAuth2 with multiple grant types including app auth. SDKs for many languages.

Zoho CRM.one_liner: Full-featured CRM suite for sales automation and customer management.
Zoho CRM.notes: Free edition available. OAuth2 only (no simple API keys). API Console for self-serve credential generation.

Close.one_liner: Sales CRM for startups and SMBs with built-in calling and email.
Close.notes: API keys use HTTP Basic Auth. OAuth2 for third-party apps. 14-day free trial.

Copper.one_liner: Google Workspace-native CRM for relationship management.
Copper.blocker: Requires paid plan for API access.
Copper.notes: API key + email header auth. REST API. Requires Professional or Business plan.

DealCloud.one_liner: Deal and relationship management platform for financial services.
DealCloud.blocker: Requires active DealCloud subscription and admin-provisioned API access.
DealCloud.notes: OAuth2 Client Credentials flow. REST API with Swagger docs. Platform Manager role needed for API access.

Zendesk.one_liner: Customer service platform with ticketing, chat, and knowledge base.
Zendesk.notes: Free trial available. Multiple auth methods including API token/email and OAuth2.

Intercom.one_liner: Customer messaging platform for sales, marketing, and support.
Intercom.notes: Free trial. Access tokens for dev, OAuth2 for marketplace apps.

Freshdesk.one_liner: Cloud-based helpdesk software for customer support ticketing.
Freshdesk.notes: Free plan includes API access. API key with Basic Auth. v2 REST API.

Front.one_liner: Shared inbox platform for team email and customer communication.
Front.notes: API tokens for personal use, OAuth2 for integrations. REST API.

Pylon.one_liner: B2B customer support platform with Slack/Teams ticket management.
Pylon.blocker: Requires paid plan; limited public API documentation.
Pylon.notes: Relatively new product. API docs exist but surface is narrow.

LiveAgent.one_liner: Multi-channel helpdesk with live chat, ticketing, and call center.
LiveAgent.notes: API key in header. REST API v3. Free trial available.

Plain.one_liner: API-first customer support platform built for modern teams.
Plain.notes: Free plan available. API-first design with GraphQL API. Bearer token auth.

Help Scout.one_liner: Help desk software for email-based customer support.
Help Scout.notes: 15-day free trial. API keys for simple access, OAuth2 for integrations. Mailbox API 2.0.

Gorgias.one_liner: E-commerce helpdesk for Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce stores.
Gorgias.blocker: Requires paid subscription for API access.
Gorgias.notes: REST API with Bearer token. OAuth2 for marketplace apps. No free tier.

Gladly.one_liner: People-centered customer service platform for enterprise brands.
Gladly.blocker: Enterprise-only, requires sales contact for access. No self-serve signup.
Gladly.notes: HTTP Basic Auth with email + API token. REST API. Enterprise pricing, no public self-serve.

Slack.one_liner: Team communication platform with channels, messaging, and integrations.
Slack.notes: Free workspace for dev. Bot tokens + OAuth2. Web API, Events API, RTM (legacy). Composio has Slack toolkit.

Twilio.one_liner: Cloud communications platform for SMS, voice, and video.
Twilio.notes: Free trial with credits. Account SID + Auth Token as Basic Auth. Broad REST API.

Zoho Cliq.one_liner: Team communication tool within the Zoho ecosystem.
Zoho Cliq.notes: Free plan available. OAuth2 via Zoho API Console. Bots and webhooks support.

Lark (Larksuite).one_liner: Enterprise collaboration suite with messaging, docs, and video meetings.
Lark (Larksuite).notes: Free plan available. App tokens and OAuth2. Extensive REST API for messages, docs, sheets, bots.

Pumble.one_liner: Free team messaging app with channels and direct messages.
Pumble.notes: Free plan. API addon generates keys via /api-keys command. SDK for custom apps. Rate limit 1000 req/min.

Discord.one_liner: Voice, video, and text communication platform for communities.
Discord.notes: Free bot creation. Bot tokens for bots, OAuth2 for user auth. Gateway (WebSocket) + REST.

Telegram.one_liner: Cloud-based messaging platform with bot API.
Telegram.notes: Free. Bot tokens from @BotFather. Simple HTTP-based Bot API. Very easy to integrate.

WhatsApp Business.one_liner: Business messaging API for customer communication at scale.
WhatsApp Business.blocker: Requires Meta Business verification and app review for production. Test mode is self-serve.
WhatsApp Business.notes: Cloud API is free tier (self-serve via Meta Developer portal). On-Premises API requires BSP. Test numbers available.

Aircall.one_liner: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams.
Aircall.blocker: API access requires paid plan (Professional or higher).
Aircall.notes: OAuth2 for public integrations, API keys for direct access. REST API. No free tier.

Vonage.one_liner: Cloud communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, and messaging.
Vonage.notes: Free trial with credits. API key + secret or JWT auth depending on product. Broad APIs (SMS, Voice, Video, Verify).

Google Ads.one_liner: Online advertising platform for search, display, and video ads.
Google Ads.blocker: Requires developer token approval from Google. OAuth2 consent screen review needed.
Google Ads.notes: OAuth2 only. Developer token required (apply via Google Ads account). Test accounts available. GAQL query language.

Meta Ads.one_liner: Advertising API for Facebook, Instagram, and Audience Network ads.
Meta Ads.blocker: Requires app review for production access. Dev mode available immediately.
Meta Ads.notes: OAuth2 via Facebook Login. Graph API. Free developer access, but app review needed for going live.

LinkedIn Ads.one_liner: Professional advertising platform for B2B marketing campaigns.
LinkedIn Ads.blocker: Marketing Developer Platform access requires application and approval.
LinkedIn Ads.notes: OAuth2 3-legged flow. REST API. Must apply for Marketing Developer Platform access.

GoHighLevel.one_liner: All-in-one marketing and CRM platform for agencies.
GoHighLevel.blocker: Requires paid subscription. API keys available in paid plans.
GoHighLevel.notes: REST API documented on Stoplight. OAuth2 for marketplace apps, API keys for direct access. Paid plans only.

Mailchimp.notes: Free plan includes API. API keys for simple auth, OAuth2 for integrations. Marketing API + Transactional API.

Klaviyo.one_liner: Marketing automation platform for e-commerce email and SMS.
Klaviyo.notes: Free plan with API access. API keys (private + public) or OAuth2. REST API with revision-based versioning.

systeme.io.one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform for funnels, email, and courses.
systeme.io.blocker: API surface is very narrow (contacts and tags only). Limited docs.
systeme.io.notes: Free plan includes API. Simple API key auth. Very limited API surface — mainly contacts/tags management.

Pinterest.one_liner: Visual discovery platform with pins, boards, and advertising.
Pinterest.blocker: App review required for production access. Sandbox available immediately.
Pinterest.notes: OAuth2. REST API v5. Free developer access with sandbox. App review for production.

Threads (Meta).one_liner: Text-based social platform by Meta, tied to Instagram.
Threads (Meta).blocker: API still relatively new with limited endpoints. App review needed.
Threads (Meta).notes: OAuth2 via Instagram/Facebook. Graph API. Publishing + insights endpoints. Still evolving.

SendGrid.one_liner: Cloud-based email delivery and marketing platform.
SendGrid.notes: Free tier (100 emails/day). API key auth via Bearer token. Broad REST API (Mail Send, Contacts, Templates, etc.).

Shopify.one_liner: E-commerce platform for online stores and retail point-of-sale.
Shopify.notes: Free partner account for dev. GraphQL (primary) + REST (legacy). OAuth2 or token exchange for embedded apps.

WooCommerce.notes: Open-source. Consumer key/secret (OAuth 1.0a). Self-hosted, so API access is inherent. Broad REST API.

BigCommerce.one_liner: SaaS e-commerce platform for multi-channel selling.
BigCommerce.notes: Free developer sandbox. OAuth2 for single-click apps, API keys for private apps. REST + Storefront GraphQL.

Salesforce Commerce Cloud.one_liner: Enterprise e-commerce platform within the Salesforce ecosystem.
Salesforce Commerce Cloud.blocker: Enterprise product requiring Salesforce partnership or client relationship. No self-serve sandbox.
Salesforce Commerce Cloud.notes: SLAS (Shopper Login and Activity Service) OAuth2. OCAPI + Commerce APIs. Enterprise-only access.

Magento (Adobe Commerce).one_liner: Open-source e-commerce platform (community edition) / enterprise commerce solution.
Magento (Adobe Commerce).notes: Open-source Magento is free and self-hosted. OAuth 1.0a for third-party apps, Bearer tokens for admin/customer. REST + GraphQL.

Squarespace.blocker: Commerce API requires Business or Commerce plan. API keys for custom integrations.
Squarespace.notes: OAuth2 for app extensions, API keys for direct access. REST API. Paid commerce plan needed for commerce endpoints.

Ecwid.one_liner: Embeddable e-commerce widget that adds a store to any website.
Ecwid.notes: Free plan includes API access. OAuth2 for apps, secret API keys for personal use. REST API.

Gumroad.one_liner: Simple e-commerce platform for creators to sell digital products.
Gumroad.notes: Free to use. OAuth2 or access token. REST API for products, sales, subscribers. Narrow surface.

Amazon Selling Partner.one_liner: API suite for Amazon marketplace sellers and vendors.
Amazon Selling Partner.blocker: Developer registration requires approval. Professional seller account needed ($39.99/mo).
Amazon Selling Partner.notes: OAuth2 via Login with Amazon (LWA). REST API. Requires developer profile registration and app listing approval.

fanbasis.one_liner: Fan engagement and e-commerce platform for creators and brands.
fanbasis.blocker: No public API documentation found. Platform appears account-gated with no developer portal.
fanbasis.notes: No discoverable public API docs. Some third-party integrations exist (Zapier) suggesting internal API, but no self-serve dev access.

DataForSEO.one_liner: SEO data API provider for SERP, keyword, and backlink data.
DataForSEO.notes: Free trial balance on signup. Basic Auth (login + password). Broad REST API: SERP, Keywords, Backlinks, OnPage.

SE Ranking.one_liner: SEO platform for rank tracking, site audits, and keyword research.
SE Ranking.notes: API key auth. REST API. Requires active paid plan for API access.

Ahrefs.one_liner: SEO toolset for backlink analysis, keyword research, and site audits.
Ahrefs.blocker: API access requires paid subscription (Lite plan or higher). API credits are limited.
Ahrefs.notes: Bearer token auth. REST API. Paid plans only, with monthly API row limits.

MrScraper.one_liner: Web scraping API for extracting data from websites.
MrScraper.notes: Free tier available. API key auth. REST API for scraping tasks.

Apify.one_liner: Web scraping and automation platform with pre-built actors.
Apify.notes: Free tier with monthly credits. API token auth. Broad REST API + Actors marketplace. Has official MCP server.

Firecrawl.one_liner: Web scraping API that converts websites to LLM-ready markdown.
Firecrawl.notes: Free tier (500 credits). API key via Bearer token. Scrape, crawl, map endpoints. Official MCP server.

Bright Data.one_liner: Web data collection platform with proxy networks and scraping APIs.
Bright Data.blocker: Free trial, but production use requires paid plan. Complex product suite.
Bright Data.notes: Free trial. API key or username/password auth. Multiple APIs: Web Unlocker, SERP, Scraping Browser, datasets.

Sherlock.one_liner: CLI tool for finding usernames across social networks.
Sherlock.blocker: CLI-only tool with no web API. No REST/GraphQL endpoints to call. Would need to wrap the CLI as a subprocess.
Sherlock.notes: Open-source Python CLI. No official API (experimental /api repo unmaintained since 2021). Install via pip/pipx.

Waterfall.io.one_liner: B2B contact discovery and data enrichment API.
Waterfall.io.blocker: Requires paid plan for API access. No free tier.
Waterfall.io.notes: API key via x-api-key header. REST API for prospect, enrich, verify. Paid plans only.

Clay.one_liner: Data enrichment and outbound automation platform for GTM teams.
Clay.blocker: API access limited; primarily a UI-driven product. Requires paid plan.
Clay.notes: Clay is primarily UI-driven with integrations via webhooks. API surface is narrow. Paid plans required.

GitHub.one_liner: Code hosting platform for version control and collaboration.
GitHub.notes: Free. PATs, GitHub Apps, OAuth Apps. REST API v3 + GraphQL v4. Official MCP server exists.

Vercel.one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for deploying web applications.
Vercel.notes: Free Hobby plan. Bearer token auth. REST API for deployments, domains, projects.

Netlify.one_liner: Web hosting and automation platform for modern web projects.
Netlify.notes: Free Starter plan. Personal access tokens or OAuth2. REST API for sites, deploys, DNS.

Cloudflare.one_liner: Web performance and security platform with CDN, DNS, and edge computing.
Cloudflare.notes: Free plan includes API access. Global API key or API tokens (scoped). Broad REST API. Official MCP server.

Supabase.one_liner: Open-source Firebase alternative with Postgres, auth, and realtime.
Supabase.notes: Free tier. anon/service_role API keys. Auto-generated REST API (PostgREST) + GraphQL (pg_graphql). Official MCP support.

Neo4j.one_liner: Graph database platform for connected data.
Neo4j.notes: Free community edition and AuraDB Free tier. Basic Auth or Bearer token. HTTP API + Bolt protocol. Cypher query language.

Snowflake.one_liner: Cloud data platform for data warehousing, lakes, and analytics.
Snowflake.notes: 30-day free trial. SQL API (REST), Snowpark. Key pair auth, OAuth, or Basic Auth. Broad API surface.

MongoDB Atlas.notes: Free M0 cluster. API key (public + private) with digest auth. Admin API + Data API (REST). Official MCP server.

Datadog.notes: Free trial (14 days). API key + Application key auth. Broad REST API covering metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards.

Sentry.one_liner: Application monitoring and error tracking platform.
Sentry.notes: Free Developer plan. Auth tokens or OAuth2 for integrations. Broad REST API for issues, events, projects.

Notion.one_liner: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, databases, and project management.
Notion.notes: Free plan. Internal integration tokens, OAuth2 for public apps, PATs. REST API. Official MCP server.

Airtable.one_liner: Spreadsheet-database hybrid for organizing and collaborating on data.
Airtable.notes: Free plan. Personal access tokens or OAuth2. REST API for bases, tables, records. Scoped tokens.

Linear.one_liner: Project and issue tracking tool for software teams.
Linear.notes: Free plan. Personal API keys or OAuth2. GraphQL API only (no REST). Well-documented.

Jira.one_liner: Issue and project tracking tool for agile software development.
Jira.notes: Free Cloud plan. API tokens (email + token as Basic Auth), OAuth 2.0 (3LO) for Forge/Connect apps. Broad REST API.

Asana.one_liner: Work management platform for team tasks and projects.
Asana.notes: Free Basic plan. Personal access tokens or OAuth2. REST API. Client libraries for multiple languages.

Monday.com.one_liner: Work OS for team management, projects, and workflows.
Monday.com.notes: Free plan (limited). API tokens or OAuth2 for marketplace apps. GraphQL API (API v2). Broad coverage.

ClickUp.one_liner: All-in-one project management and productivity platform.
ClickUp.notes: Free plan. Personal API tokens or OAuth2. REST API v2 with broad coverage (tasks, spaces, goals, etc.).

Coda.one_liner: Doc-based collaboration tool that blends documents and spreadsheets.
Coda.notes: Free plan. API tokens (Bearer) or OAuth2 for pack development. REST API for docs, tables, rows, formulas.

Smartsheet.one_liner: Enterprise work management platform for project planning and collaboration.
Smartsheet.notes: 30-day free trial. Access tokens or OAuth2. REST API 2.0. SDKs for Java, C#, Node, Python.

Harvest.one_liner: Time tracking and invoicing tool for teams and freelancers.
Harvest.notes: Free plan (1 user). Personal access tokens or OAuth2. REST API v2 for time entries, projects, invoices.

Stripe.one_liner: Online payment processing platform for internet businesses.
Stripe.notes: Free to create account and test. API keys (secret/publishable/restricted) + OAuth2 for Connect/Apps. Very broad REST API.

Plaid.one_liner: Financial data API for connecting bank accounts to applications.
Plaid.notes: Free Sandbox environment. client_id + secret as API keys. REST API for accounts, transactions, identity, etc.

Binance.one_liner: Cryptocurrency exchange platform for trading digital assets.
Binance.notes: Free account. API key + secret with HMAC signing. REST + WebSocket APIs. Spot, margin, futures.

Paygent Connect.one_liner: Japanese payment gateway for credit cards, QR codes, and convenience store payments.
Paygent Connect.blocker: Japanese enterprise payment gateway requiring merchant partnership agreement. No self-serve developer access.
Paygent Connect.notes: Separate entity from NMI despite confusing assignment hint. Japanese market only. Requires merchant contract.

iPayX.blocker: No verifiable public API documentation found. Website/docs URL unclear and potentially inactive.
iPayX.notes: Cannot verify API existence or auth. Multiple unrelated 'iPay' services globally create confusion. No discoverable developer docs.

QuickBooks.notes: Free sandbox. OAuth 2.0. REST API for invoices, customers, payments, reports. Intuit Developer portal.

Xero.one_liner: Cloud accounting software for small and medium businesses.
Xero.notes: Free demo company for dev. OAuth 2.0 (PKCE). REST API for accounting, payroll, projects, files.

Brex.one_liner: Corporate card and spend management platform for startups.
Brex.blocker: API access requires Brex account (business customers only).
Brex.notes: User tokens or OAuth2. REST API for accounts, transactions, users, cards. Requires Brex customer account.

Ramp.one_liner: Corporate card and expense management automation.
Ramp.blocker: API access requires Ramp business account.
Ramp.notes: Bearer tokens or OAuth2. REST API for transactions, receipts, accounting. Requires Ramp customer account.

PitchBook.one_liner: Financial data and research platform for private capital markets.
PitchBook.blocker: Enterprise-only. Requires active PitchBook subscription + separate API contract. Credit-based pricing.
PitchBook.notes: PB-Token header auth. REST API. No self-serve access. Must contact account manager for API key.

NotebookLM.one_liner: AI-powered research and note-taking tool by Google (now Gemini Notebook).
NotebookLM.blocker: No public consumer API. Enterprise API requires Gemini Enterprise or Education Premium license through Google Cloud.
NotebookLM.notes: Enterprise-only API (Gemini Notebook API). Consumer product has no API. Unofficial wrappers exist but are unsupported.

Otter AI.one_liner: AI meeting assistant for transcription and note-taking.
Otter AI.blocker: API access requires paid Business plan. MCP server available but documentation is limited.
Otter AI.notes: Has MCP server. API docs limited. Requires Business plan for API/integration features.

Fathom.blocker: No public API documentation found. Product is consumer-facing with no developer portal.
Fathom.notes: No discoverable public API or developer docs. Integrates with CRMs via built-in connectors, not an open API.

Consensus.blocker: Enterprise API access by application. MCP server available with OAuth2 PKCE.
Consensus.notes: OAuth2 with PKCE for MCP. API keys for REST. Enterprise/application-based access. Has MCP server.

Reducto.one_liner: AI document parsing API for extracting structured data from PDFs and documents.
Reducto.notes: Free tier available. API key (Bearer token). REST API for document parsing, extraction, chunking.

Devin.one_liner: AI software engineer by Cognition Labs.
Devin.blocker: Requires paid Devin subscription. API/MCP access included with plan.
Devin.notes: Has MCP server and REST API. Bearer token auth. Requires paid Teams plan ($500/mo). Can trigger sessions via API.

higgsfield.one_liner: AI content generation platform for images and videos via CLI and API.
higgsfield.notes: Free tier. CLI + API + MCP. Authenticate via `higgsfield auth login`. 30+ generative models. npm installable.

Mermaid CLI.one_liner: Command-line tool for generating diagrams from Mermaid markdown definitions.
Mermaid CLI.blocker: Local CLI/Node.js library only. No web API or SaaS endpoint. Would require wrapping the CLI as a subprocess.
Mermaid CLI.notes: Open-source npm package. CLI tool (mmdc command). Has a Node.js API but no REST/HTTP endpoints. Not a SaaS product.

YouTube Transcript.one_liner: Third-party API service for extracting YouTube video transcripts.
YouTube Transcript.notes: Third-party service (not official YouTube). API key auth. REST API. Free tier available. Narrow surface (transcripts only).

Grain.one_liner: AI meeting recording platform with highlights and sharing.
Grain.blocker: API access requires Business plan. Limited public API documentation.
Grain.notes: OAuth2 for integrations. Limited API surface. Requires paid plan for API access. Integrations mainly CRM-focused.
